title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Released
description: The mid-semester examinations for B.Tech CSE (3rd and 5th semester) will begin on 25 November 2026. Students must carry their ID cards and admit cards to every exam.

title: Hackathon: Code for Campus 2026
description: The IT department is organising a 24-hour hackathon on 28 November in the Seminar Hall. Teams of 3 to 4 students can register with their class coordinator before 22 November.

title: Embedded Systems Lab Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop on Arduino and ESP32 will be held in the ECE Lab (Block B) on 20 November from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Limited seats, first come first served.

title: Industrial Visit to Manufacturing Plant
description: Final-year ME students will visit an automobile manufacturing plant on 30 November. Please submit the signed consent form to the department office by 24 November.

title: Guest Lecture on Sustainable Construction
description: An industry expert will speak on green building materials and sustainable construction practices on 19 November at 11:00 AM in Room C-204. All Civil students are encouraged to attend.

title: Project Submission Deadline Extended
description: The deadline for final-year project report submission has been extended to 5 December 2026. Submit one hard copy and one soft copy to your project guide.
